name: info-pane
description: Harness UI for Claude Code: an info pane (recap, surfaced asks and notes, pins, tasks, responses), a prompt context drawer and a status line

infoPane.title: Info pane
infoPane.description: A side pane with the recap, surfaced asks and notes, pinned replies, open questions, tasks and a list of responses

contextDrawer.title: Prompt context drawer
contextDrawer.description: A row above the prompt naming the prompt behind the replies in view; hover to see it, click to jump to it, /context-drawer to read it in full

statusline.title: Status line collector
statusline.description: Collect this session's model request totals (uncached input, output, cache reads) for the harness-ui status line renderer in Claude Code's own statusLine slot; draws nothing itself

activity.title: Share activity
activity.description: Record in this session's shared state whether it is working or waiting on you, for session viewers such as the session sidebar. auto: while any feature of this plugin is on

sessionSidebar.title: Session sidebar
sessionSidebar.description: A narrow pane listing the sessions running here, one line each; press one to switch to its tab in this window (Claude Code docks it on the right)

showClaude.title: Session sidebar: Claude Code sessions
showClaude.description: List Claude Code sessions in the session sidebar

showCodex.title: Session sidebar: Codex sessions
showCodex.description: List Codex sessions in the session sidebar

switchTabs.title: Session sidebar: switch tabs
switchTabs.description: Let the session sidebar switch to another tab of this window

switchPanes.title: Session sidebar: switch panes
switchPanes.description: Let it switch to a tab split into panes, when the pane is where this one is and the same size
